_comment: CP-PLAT-M10.1 performance-regression baseline. Means (ns) from a quick-pass Criterion run (--warm-up-time 0.2 --measurement-time 1.0 --sample-size 20) of the hot paths: Value::parse, DC op-point, and Backward-Euler transient. Regenerate after an intentional, reviewed perf change with `python3 -I benches/ci/compare.py --update`. The threshold is wide because GitHub-hosted runners are noisy; treat the number as a trend guard.
